# AgileXR

> World-class offshore software development and outsourcing. Senior engineers across mobile apps, API development, QA testing, cloud infrastructure, and SAP implementation.

AgileXR is an offshore software development and outsourcing firm that provides senior engineering teams to growth-stage companies and enterprise teams with capability gaps. The firm delivers mobile apps (iOS, Android, React Native), API development, QA testing, web hosting, SAP implementation, and AWS configuration.

## Company

- **Name**: AgileXR
- **Website**: https://agilexr.com
- **Email**: info@agilexr.com
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agilexr
- **Positioning**: World's best offshore development and outsourcing

## Key Stats

- 100+ projects delivered
- 50+ senior engineers
- 8+ years operating
- 3 global delivery centers

## Services

### API Development
REST, GraphQL, and microservices built for production. Includes authentication, rate limiting, documentation, third-party integrations, and monitoring. Stacks: Node.js, Python, Go, Java, .NET, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, GCP.

### Mobile App Development
iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin), and cross-platform (React Native/Expo). App Store and Google Play submission experience included. Stacks: Swift, SwiftUI, Kotlin, React Native, Expo, Firebase, AWS Amplify.

### Quality Assurance (QA Testing)
Manual and automated QA across functional, regression, performance, and security. CI/CD pipeline integration. Stacks: Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, Jest, k6, JMeter, BrowserStack, GitHub Actions.

### Web Hosting & Cloud Infrastructure
Cloud environment setup, containerization, infrastructure as code, CDN, monitoring, and disaster recovery. Stacks: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nginx, Cloudflare.

### SAP Implementation
SAP S/4HANA implementation, ECC migration, BTP development, ABAP/Fiori, integration, and data migration. Certified SAP consultants. Stacks: SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, ABAP, Fiori, SAP Integration Suite.

### AWS Configuration
Architecture review, environment setup, cost optimization, EC2/ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, CloudFront, VPC, CloudWatch monitoring. Stacks: EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, Aurora, CloudFront, S3, IAM.

## How It Works

1. Discovery call (30 minutes, no pitch)
2. Team scoping and engineer match (48-hour proposal turnaround)
3. Sprint kickoff within two weeks

## Operating Principles

- Senior engineers only — no junior outsourcing, no training on your project
- Your process, your tools — we work inside Jira, Linear, GitHub, Slack, whatever you use
- Transparent communication — weekly written status reports, direct engineer Slack access, one dedicated technical lead
- Ownership over delivery — we co-own the outcome, not just the hours
- Build to hand off — all code documented and reviewed with the assumption that another team inherits it
